common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a finished, high-fidelity horizontal desktop WEBSITE SECTION design image, 1792x1024 landscape, not an infographic or presentation slide. This is Nori, an open-source organization super agent for nonprofits and NGOs. Use a consistent premium Grok-Bot-like clean Swiss grotesk visual world: white #FFFFFF, black #101010, crisp grey hairlines, controlled generous whitespace, black rounded primary buttons, compact native software typography. Character color is the accent; do not wash backgrounds with pastel. Actual content, hierarchy and outcome dominate. No purple-blue gradients, no soft clay UI, no huge app logos, no inflated message fonts, no invented Nori dashboard, no fake performance metrics. Native software fragments should have believable compact spacing, menu/icon scale and UI language. A full interface keeps natural 976:660 proportions; excerpt cards keep natural aspect and normal font sizes. Realistic thin surfaces, fine 1px borders, shallow 3D z-axis depth, small perspective (1-3 degrees only), physically plausible separated shadows, important text unobscured. No giant tilt or isometric desk.
Image 1 reference is ONLY the accepted Nori identity and badge construction: transparent employee card sleeve, black fabric lanyard, metal clip, half-body employee photograph INSIDE badge. Do not copy old role titles, navigation, typography, or four-badge exact layout. Image 2 is original identity reference: mint hair with pink forelock, cat ears, antenna/headset, two simple black vertical capsule eyes, ivory face. Keep this identity; simplify cheek blush, professional restrained expression. Bold hair variants can be cobalt/silver, amber, violet, copper, deep teal. OUTSIDE employee badge portraits show HEAD ONLY as small avatars, no neck/chest/bust, no large mascot beside work. No 'Listen -> Coordinate' decorative arrow process strip. No 'Reconstructed demo'. No outside reference brand names in website copy. Scenario fragments are proposed examples, not actual organization records: where scenes appear add one discreet footer 'Illustrative scenario.' Do not invent verification badges, financial totals, dates, account handles, testimonials, famous endorsements or transaction hashes. English copy only, render supplied copy accurately. Do not put section numbers or art-director instructions on the website.

images.name: 首屏 · 工作不因负责人离线而停下
images.prompt: Hero section, stacked center composition. ONLY this section has a compact top navigation: small Nori mint/pink head + Nori wordmark, 'What Nori does', 'Meet the team', 'Running with Rein', 'Open source'; unobtrusive pilot link. Large central headline EXACT 'Meet Nori. Built to help run your organization.' split cleanly into two lines. Eyebrow 'An open-source super agent for organizations.' Supporting 'Daily operations, governance, treasury, community, and growth—carried forward over the long term.' Audience 'Built with nonprofits and NGOs in mind.' Main black pill 'Meet Nori in Discord', secondary outline 'Become a pilot organization'. Lower half: generous wide work-scene composition, a readable cropped Slack thread dominant, normal compact UI, not a whole app squeezed tiny. Channel #program-ops. Nori avatar tiny. Messages: Nori 'The partner update is due tomorrow. Alex is on leave; I found the missing project notes and asked Maya to check the summary.' Maya 'Reviewed. The summary is ready to share.' Nori 'Sent through the agreed channel. The handoff is recorded.' Exactly two supporting thin artifact cards offset on distinct z planes, neither obscuring messages: calendar crop 'Alex · Out of office' and document crop 'Partner update / Project evidence attached / Handoff recorded'. Main thread elevated with distinct shadow, one discreet pointer resting near 'View case ↗'. The work story occupies useful width, no mascot wall, no carousel dots.

images.name: 工牌 · 从高管到一线
images.prompt: Employee identity badge section. Headline exact 'One Nori. Many roles. A working organization.' Small supporting 'Executive accountability, support for your people, and hands-on execution.' Six beautifully rendered physical ID cards across a gently staggered horizontal display with enough clear width for accurate job titles, NOT repetitive flat web cards. Preserve accepted reference's transparent acrylic sleeves, metallic clips, black woven straps, shallow shadows and professional half-body portraits INSIDE badges ONLY. All badges have small 'NORI' and 'Rein Protocol Foundation', principal title exactly these SIX roles, 2-line wrapping allowed: 'Chief Operating Officer', 'Chief People Officer', 'Chief Financial Officer', 'Executive Secretary', 'Community Operator', 'Software Engineer'. Distinct hair colors respectively mint with pink forelock, saturated amber/gold, cobalt with silver forelock and glasses, violet with headset, copper/coral with a black baseball cap, deep teal with pale accent. Same original cat ears, two black capsule eyes, antenna/headset and Nori hair silhouette, neutral professional faces. Portrait attire graphite suits/knits or restrained casual; no Japanese idol cuteness. Small quiet role-selection detail underneath one selected badge 'Community Operator' with 'Member onboarding · Contributor support' and compact adjacent labels 'Discord' and 'GitHub' joined by a single subtle connector. This is work/channel relationship not a logo wall. Do not use Operations / Finance / Creative as job titles. No Manager anywhere. Do not include navigation or disclaimers on this section. Plenty of white breathing room.

images.name: 内部运营 · 先调用已有资源
images.prompt: Operations section with strong top-left headline EXACT 'Take care of the work behind a working team.' Supporting one sentence 'Finds the right services. Gets them in place. Follows the work through.' Below a small elegant text tab row 'Everyday requests' selected black underline, 'Global hiring', 'Payroll & leave', 'Board work'. Main story 'A new tool request. An existing seat.' Use image-as-canvas with one large readable Slack thread fragment anchored middle-left, nearly face-on and naturally proportioned, two smaller genuine-looking artifacts at upper-right and lower-right with layered shadows. Slack #employee-help, message from 'Team member': 'Can I get access to the research tool before Monday?' Nori: 'We already have an unused seat. I’ve assigned it and sent your access link.' Member: 'I’m in. Thank you.' Nori: 'Access checked. The inventory is updated.' Second artifact an ordinary admin seat detail crop, not fictional Nori app: 'Research workspace / Seat available / Assigned to team member'. Third artifact a compact email 'Access is ready / Sign in to your workspace'. Show subtle hover lift of main case with cursor and 'View case ↗'. Narrow typographic lower detail area for deeper case selection: 'Cross-border onboarding / Visa sponsorship · E-Verify · Employment services', with a right arrow opening link. Keep headline and native card texts very distinct scales. No enormous Slack logo or purple fake toolbar. Rich whitespace and black fine-rule structure; no huge mascot. No top nav.

images.name: 财务 · 日常资金与受限链上执行
images.prompt: Finance and crypto section, editorial asymmetry on neutral very light grey, black strong heading EXACT 'Put the organization’s resources to work.' Support 'Treasury, payments, fundraising, and everyday commerce—through established platforms.' Story navigation 'Expense follow-through' selected, 'On-chain work', 'Storefront & support', 'Funding opportunities'. Main area 60% width: one large near-frontal finance case built from an email/accounting thread crop 'The receipt that closes the loop' / 'Missing purpose: workshop expense' / Nori 'Matched to the workshop booking. Receipt attached; project coding is ready for review.' Supporting slim attachment crop 'Workshop booking / Receipt attached'. On right 35% a refined interactive-preview component for secondary crypto case 'Limited working funds. Separate reserves.' Display three spaced horizontal strata with fine divider, not cartoon wallet: 'Organization reserves / Independently controlled'; 'Project budget / Purpose-bound allocation'; 'Nori hot wallet / Limited operating funds'. Only bottom stratum slightly elevated. Under it a tiny readable smart-contract action crop 'Project grant / Contract interaction / Within working limit / Record linked to project'. Beneath sensible text 'Ethereum · BNB Chain · Solana' and 'Insurance & custody / Coverage and renewal follow-up'. No numbers, fake transfer hashes, balances, pretend real transaction evidence, or all-assets dashboard. Bottom quiet scenario links 'Stripe storefront & donations' 'PayPal payment follow-up' 'Banking with the required human steps'. No unsupported integration wall or giant payment brand logos. Main visual is daily expenses; crypto gets real visible dedicated spatial treatment, not omitted. One small 'Illustrative scenario.' No nav or mascot.

images.name: 社区 · 新人到开源贡献者
images.prompt: Community section, generous white. Headline EXACT 'A community that builds with Nori.' Supporting 'Find a first contribution, work through a real problem, and help shape what Nori can do next.' Below prominent two-option story selector: 'Your first contribution' selected; 'When Nori needs human expertise' unselected with small 'Paid collaboration' label. MAIN DEFAULT STORY title 'From saying hello to shipping a first contribution.' Composition a premium shallow 3D stage with dominant readable Discord DARK native thread crop at left/middle and precisely TWO supporting natural GitHub excerpt cards at different z-depth on right. Discord uses compact real-message formatting, small server/channel cues #start-contributing, no invented giant logos or toy borders. New member 'I know Python and have a few hours this week. Where can I help?' Nori tiny mint avatar 'There’s a focused retry test we need. I’ll help you set up the project and work through the acceptance checks.' New member 'The environment is working. I’ve opened a PR.' Nori 'I’ve requested a reviewer. Let’s work through their feedback together.' GitHub issue upper-right 'Add a retry regression test / good first issue / Reproduce the failure / Cover the retry path'; GitHub PR lower-right foreground 'First contribution / Checks passed / Review feedback addressed / Merged', small credit 'Thank you for contributing.' Artifacts do not cover message text. One cursor over PR with hover lift and black 'View case ↗' affordance. Small bottom preview link 'When the task needs specialist help, Nori brings people in.' No decorative arrows, no bust, no process strip, no fabricated live user avatar photos. Names generic. One discreet illustrative scenario note.

images.name: 传播 · 反馈形成下一次行动
images.prompt: Communications section with off-grid editorial composition but precise reading order. Large headline EXACT 'Give the organization a voice that stays active.' Supporting 'Share the work. Join relevant conversations. Bring useful feedback back into the organization.' Use selectable content view, not crowded all-case wall: text tabs 'Post & reply' selected, 'Quote & share', 'Short video', 'Live conversations', 'Supporter updates'. Main three artifacts show a linked story in shallow z planes. Broad native X post and reply excerpt at middle left: account display 'Rein Protocol Foundation' (no fake handle or verified mark), post 'Our contributor office hours are taking shape. Bring a question, a small fix, or an idea for safer agents.' Reply by 'Community member': 'Is there a beginner-friendly way to prepare?' Nori reply 'Yes. We’re adding a setup guide based on the questions from this thread.' Adjacent smaller genuine GitHub document change crop upper-right 'Contributor guide / Setup walkthrough added / Reviewed'. Foreground portrait 9:16 video excerpt at far right, authentic short video UI scale, editorial close-up of hands/code on a laptop (no invented people or event photography presented as evidence), caption 'Your first contribution, in one minute', clear player controls. The video is an illustrative storyboard, not recorded event. A tiny quote/repost preview appears only in the tab label zone if space, not a fourth full artifact. MAIN point is feedback led to change and returned to participants. No fake likes/counts, celebrity mentions, giant mascot, process arrows or huge app logos. Keep black/white website, platform-native small colors, deep credible shadows and fine surfaces. No navigation.

images.name: Rein · 组织级主案例
images.prompt: A quieter editorial case-study section tying the prior stories to Rein Protocol Foundation. White and graphite split composition with a dark charcoal editorial text panel on left (about 42%) and white working-artifact area on right, generous margins. Exact headline 'Meet Nori at Rein Protocol Foundation.' Supporting 'A nonprofit focused on AI safety and making AI agents safe for people and society.' Black panel white type, small secondary line 'Explore how organization-level work connects around a shared mission.' CTA white pill 'Meet Nori in Discord'. Small explanation 'Meet Nori in the community, explore projects, and take part.' Right side shows ONE considered document-like case study opening 'An AI safety project, carried forward.' with mission, project questions and contributors, and TWO linked compact excerpts from previous scenes: a Github contributor test PR fragment and a supporter project update email. They sit on shallow separated z planes, almost frontal and readable. Short labels 'Project purpose', 'Community contributions', 'Supporter communication' arranged editorially adjacent to evidence fragments, NOT diagram nodes or arrows, no five-step process strip. All artifacts visibly modest and marked in group footer 'Illustrative project journey. Public records to be added.' Do not invent real project success, savings, statistics, foundation endorsements, actual receipts or release dates. Head-only mint Nori avatar small within artifacts, no bust or ornamental hero character. No repeated navigation.

images.name: 连续性 · 下一位成员能够接着做
images.prompt: Long-term continuity website section, minimal editorial calm between larger cases. Exact large headline at upper-left 'The work continues—even as the organization changes.' Supporting 'Keep decisions, commitments, and relationships connected across weeks, quarters, and team changes.' Below a spacious horizontal desk-like arrangement of THREE thin actual work-artifact crops with restrained differing sizes and shallow z-depth, no arrows or timeline line. Large document on left 'Quarterly decisions / Continue contributor office hours / Follow-up owner recorded / Next review prepared'. Middle highest foreground 'Handoff notes / Context, decisions, open commitments / Next person ready to continue'. Right email excerpt 'Supporter update / What changed since our last conversation / Project evidence and next steps'. Use proper text density of documents and email, short excerpt to remain legible; no fake dashboard or metrics. Tiny source-context badges 'Board notes', 'Team handoff', 'Donor relationship'. Below on one clean typographic line 'Clear roles. Appropriate access. A record of what happened.' Head-only Nori icon tiny where author appears. Pure white with thin graphite rules, restrained natural shadows, no mascot, pastel wash, process arrows, six-card grid or navigation. Quiet footer 'Illustrative scenario.' This should feel like organizational memory made tangible, not a feature wall.

images.name: 开源与参与 · 清晰收束

Built with the community.' Below two lines 'Nori brings together ideas from the open-source community to explore what long-term organizational agents can become.' Footer thin rule and Nori wordmark, 'Rein Protocol Foundation', 'Open source', 'Community'. No fictional partners, OpenClaw/DeepSeek/MagPie logo lists, app download, install command, invented launch claims or legal links. Plenty of breathing room, polished grounded typography. This is a calm footer not a wall of cards. No navigation.

images.name: 交互状态 · Nori 向人类寻求专业帮助
images.prompt: This ONE supplemental image is a DESIGN REVIEW STATE SHEET, landscape 1792x1024, same Nori website visual system. Show exact top title 'Case cards: depth that responds.' Under title three labeled aligned columns, 'Rest', 'Hover', 'Open case'. This is NOT a decorative process strip and do not draw arrows joining columns. Left narrow 25% column has a cropped Discord Nori call-for-help card 'When Nori needs expertise, it brings people in.' Message 'I’ve narrowed the issue to the retry path. I need a developer and an independent tester.' Normal compact dark Discord styling, tiny Nori mint/pink head avatar, two thin supporting planes behind showing GitHub issue and paid task brief, all titles visible. Middle 30% column shows SAME composition SAME size, cursor over foreground case; lift main card visibly above old baseline, clearer shadow, slight 2-degree tilt, 'View case ↗'. Tiny design annotation under: '+32px depth · ±2° tilt · 180ms'. No dramatic isometric twist. Right 40% column shows expanded white case details panel with close X, small 'Paid collaboration' eyebrow, title 'Nori found the problem—and the people to solve it.' Subhead 'Donation confirmation retry issue'. Clear case copy in four editorial groups: 'Context / Payment confirmation occasionally falls out of sync.' 'Nori’s action / Prepared a sanitized reproduction and scoped a paid task.' 'People & platforms / A developer implements the fix; a second contributor tests failure cases. Existing code, contract and payment tools carry the work.' 'Acceptance & settlement / Review the fix, verify independent tests, then follow through on the agreed payment.' Include short native GitHub test-result crop 'Retry and duplicate-event tests / Passed' as an ILLUSTRATIVE scenario with no false transaction record. Small bottom details link 'Reproduction · Acceptance checks · Review notes'. Under whole sheet discreet design notes 'Leave: 220ms reset   Keyboard: focus + Enter   Touch: tap to open   Reduced motion: no tilt   Escape: close & restore focus'. Exact note 'Static interaction states — not a working prototype.' No full-body Nori; no nonexistent real actions performed; no buttons that read Send payment or Hire now. Focus on tactile depth and actual meaningful case expansion.
